# LLM call

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-docs.mjs. Edit the manifest, then run `make docs`. -->

Send a prompt to OpenRouter, Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, or any OpenAI-compatible API

```yaml
- uses: patrickisgreat/actions-toolkit/actions/llm-call@v1
  with:
    model: # Model identifier, in the provider's own naming (e.g. `anthropic/claude-sonnet-5`).
```

## How it works

Call an LLM from a workflow step and get back text, token usage, and an estimated cost.

This is the single provider seam for every non-agentic LLM use in the toolkit — release
note drafting, triage classification, changelog summarisation, eval graders. Adding a
provider means editing this file, not every workflow that wants a completion.

  openrouter (default) → one API key, hundreds of models, automatic fallback across
                         upstream providers. `model` uses OpenRouter's `vendor/model`
                         form (`anthropic/claude-sonnet-5`, `openai/gpt-5.2`).
  anthropic            → Anthropic Messages API directly.
  openai               → OpenAI Chat Completions.
  gemini               → Google Generative Language API.
  groq | together | deepseek | xai | mistral | ollama | custom
                       → OpenAI-compatible `/chat/completions` endpoints. `custom` takes
                         an explicit `base-url`, which also covers self-hosted vLLM,
                         LM Studio, and LiteLLM proxies.

Why OpenRouter is the default: it decouples the workflow from any one vendor's outage,
rate limit, or model deprecation, and it reports real spend per request in the response
so `cost-usd` is measured rather than estimated. For the direct providers, cost is
computed from `price-per-1m-input`/`-output` when you supply them, and omitted otherwise —
a wrong number is worse than no number.

The prompt is written to a file and posted as JSON built by jq. It is never interpolated
into a shell command or a JSON string by hand, so issue titles, PR bodies, and diffs can
be passed through safely.

## Inputs

| Input | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `provider` | no | `openrouter` | openrouter \| anthropic \| openai \| gemini \| groq \| together \| deepseek \| xai \| mistral \| ollama \| custom |
| `model` | **yes** | — | Model identifier, in the provider's own naming (e.g. `anthropic/claude-sonnet-5`). |
| `prompt` | no | `""` | The user message. Mutually exclusive with `prompt-file`. |
| `prompt-file` | no | `""` | Read the user message from this file. Takes precedence over `prompt`. |
| `system` | no | `""` | System prompt. |
| `api-key` | no | `""` | API key for the selected provider. Not required for `ollama`. |
| `base-url` | no | `""` | API base URL. Required for `custom`; overrides the default for any provider. |
| `max-tokens` | no | `4096` | Maximum tokens to generate. |
| `temperature` | no | `0` | Sampling temperature. |
| `json-schema` | no | `""` | JSON Schema for structured output. When set, the model is constrained to emit conforming JSON and the result is validated before the step succeeds. Supported on openrouter/openai/gemini and the OpenAI-compatible providers. |
| `output-file` | no | `""` | Write the response text to this file as well as to the step output. |
| `fallback-models` | no | `""` | Comma-separated models to try in order if the primary fails. OpenRouter routes these server-side; other providers retry client-side. |
| `price-per-1m-input` | no | `""` | USD per 1M input tokens, for cost reporting on direct providers. Empty omits cost. |
| `price-per-1m-output` | no | `""` | USD per 1M output tokens. |
| `retries` | no | `3` | Retry attempts on 429 or 5xx, with exponential backoff. |
| `timeout` | no | `300` | Per-request timeout in seconds. |
| `fail-on-error` | no | `true` | false to record the failure in outputs and continue instead of failing the step. |

## Outputs

| Output | Description |
|---|---|
| `text` | The generated text. Empty when the call failed and `fail-on-error` is false. |
| `json` | The parsed JSON object, when `json-schema` was used. |
| `output-file` | Path the response was written to, when `output-file` was set. |
| `input-tokens` | Prompt tokens consumed. |
| `output-tokens` | Completion tokens generated. |
| `cost-usd` | Cost in USD — reported by OpenRouter, computed from prices elsewhere, else empty. |
| `model` | The model that actually served the request (may differ if a fallback was used). |
| `success` | `true` if the call returned a completion. |
